tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate performance of signals created in the last N days (default 30) that have since resolved: hit rate, verified count, average leverage and a breakdown by direction; with an API key also average ROI per signal and cumulative ROI. byMonth: hit rate this month, the two months before and all time

tools.name: get_signal_history
